KernelTopicWeights, row by rowSumWhat it does
Identity4.4.10, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 01leaves the image unchanged; the starting point for a custom kernel
Box blur (mean)4.4.41/9, 1/9, 1/9, 1/9, 1/9, 1/9, 1/9, 1/9, 1/91replaces each pixel with the average of its nine-pixel neighbourhood
Gaussian blur4.4.90.075, 0.124, 0.075, 0.124, 0.204, 0.124, 0.075, 0.124, 0.0751a weighted average that gives the centre pixel the most say
Sharpen4.4.110, -1, 0, -1, 5, -1, 0, -1, 01boosts the centre and subtracts its neighbours, exaggerating local change
Laplacian4.4.110, -1, 0, -1, 4, -1, 0, -1, 00a second derivative: it peaks on both sides of an edge at once
Sobel X4.5.3-1, 0, 1, -2, 0, 2, -1, 0, 10estimates the horizontal gradient, so it finds vertical edges
Sobel Y4.5.3-1, -2, -1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 2, 10estimates the vertical gradient, so it finds horizontal edges
Prewitt X4.5.4-1, 0, 1, -1, 0, 1, -1, 0, 10an unweighted Sobel X; the same idea with equal row weights
Emboss4.4.11-2, -1, 0, -1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 21a directional derivative plus one, which reads as a lit relief
